package_bundle_packs_empty.description: Workflow #411 A40: the pack table holds no pack. package bundle's --packs-root holds no pack directory (path packs, the standard package's pack directory), or the bundle.json that actinglab standard-pack check reads lists no pack (path bundle.json, json_pointer /packs). Paths are relative to the standard package, never absolute local paths. Workflow #407 LOAD-1: also actinglab package loading's --packs-root holding no pack directory (path packs).

package_bundle_write_failed.description: A package bundle directory could not be written: write failed. Workflow #407 LOAD-1: also a pack's loading copy that actinglab package loading --write could not write; the message names the file and the files already written, and nothing is removed.

package_bundle_navigation_package_invali.description: Workflow #373 NAV-T (M-373 v1.1 §3.9): a package that a standard-pack root file names (the feature package of pages.json, an edge or recovery chain step of navigation.json, a handler or then.run package of interrupts.json) cannot play its part, as the Runtime would refuse it with contained_task_navigation_package_invalid: same navigation_role and navigation_problem. package bundle and actinglab standard-pack check report it; admission_failed carries the loader's refusal as its cause.
package_bundle_navigation_package_invali.common_causes: The feature package's pages are not exactly the page list; an edge's package does not start on its from page or end on its to page, or is an application entry; a recovery chain, handler or then.run package declares a prerequisite package; a handler's entry does not hold its interrupt page; a package's declarations keep it from a layer (recognize_only, stability termination, post-admission OCR, readings, a designated operation, an on_empty select step).
package_bundle_navigation_package_invali.handling: Fix the root file or the named package so that it fits its part, then bundle or check again.

package_bundle_entry_page_unlisted.description: Workflow #373 NAV-T (M-373 v1.1 §4.4, §10.1 NAV-4): a pack's entry pages are not all pages of pages.json (page_ids lists those that are not), so the Runtime does not navigate to the pack's entry and records contained_task_navigation_entry_unlisted instead. package bundle and actinglab standard-pack check list one per such pack: the report the resource CI reads.
package_bundle_entry_page_unlisted.common_causes: The page list does not list the pack's entry page yet, or the pack names its entry page by another id than the list's.
package_bundle_entry_page_unlisted.handling: Add the page to pages.json and its feature package, or align the pack's entry page id with the list.

recognition_pack_undeclared.description: Workflow #384 D2-S2 (transitional warning): a pack of a bundle generated with maintenance declarations only navigates and reads (it qualifies as a recognition maintenance package), and the declarations name no recognition package for its server (variant). Workflow #411 A32: only the one package a server declares counts, so the other qualifying packs of a server that declares one raise nothing. The resource repositories make it an error once their recognition packages are declared (D2-S6).
recognition_pack_undeclared.common_causes: A server of the standard package declares no recognition maintenance package in maintenance.json.
recognition_pack_undeclared.handling: Declare, for each server, its one recognition maintenance package with the use recognition.

selection_policy_limit_exceeded.description: A resource conversion read a selection policy document above its size limit.

package_bundle_remedy_invalid.description: Workflow #411 B15 (contracts/remedies.md, contracts/package-reference.md): a package's remedy cannot be served inside its game root (remedy_problem capability_unprovided: no package of the root provides the capability a remedy names; cycle: the packages' remedies and provided capabilities form a cycle, one entry per package on it; parameters_mismatch: two providers of one capability declare different parameters). need, capability and outcome_key name the remedy where they apply. package bundle and actinglab standard-pack check list one entry in warnings per finding; nothing is refused, and the Runtime stops such a remedy for a person at run time.
package_bundle_remedy_invalid.common_causes: A provider package not written yet or not listed in bundle.json.
package_bundle_remedy_invalid.handling: Add or fix the provider package, or remove the capability from the remedy.

package_bundle_interrupt_page_shadowed.description: Workflow #411 B35 (contracts/package-reference.md, the standard-pack cross-check; contracts/README.md, shared interrupt pages): a package of the game root declares page_id, which interrupts.json lists as a shared interrupt page. A page a package declares is its own, so that shared interrupt page does not act for the package's runs, and adding it to interrupts.json changes nothing for them. package bundle and actinglab standard-pack check list one entry in warnings per package and such page; a feature package of pages.json and a handler of that page declare it by their part and are not listed. Nothing is refused.
package_bundle_interrupt_page_shadowed.common_causes: The package recognises the dialog itself, written before the shared interrupt page existed.
package_bundle_interrupt_page_shadowed.handling: Remove the page from the package so that the shared interrupt page handles it, or keep it when the package must handle that page itself.

package_bundle_store_tap_unlocated.description: STORE-FG-1 (design-store-fg §8.1; contracts/resource-declarations.md, store update packages; contracts/package-reference.md, the standard-pack cross-check): a package of the game root declares store_update, and the store operation pack_operation_id taps a fixed place (click kind point, rect or specific_rect) rather than a target located on the frame. A store's buttons move between devices and layouts, so such a tap can land on another button. package bundle and actinglab standard-pack check list one entry in warnings per package and such operation. Nothing is refused: kernel admission still takes the package.
package_bundle_store_tap_unlocated.common_causes: The store step was written from one device's frame with the button's position.
package_bundle_store_tap_unlocated.handling: Tap a text target located on the frame (click kind target or offset with a verify_text guard on the button's own label).

package_bundle_preprocess_divergent.description: Workflow #428 CFL-2 (contracts/recognition-preprocess.md, Hand-over; contracts/selection-graph.md, Shared OCR read): an OCR target that a fixed_slots layout's slots or features read lies inside the layout's shared read with its model and languages, but its preprocess chain differs from the shared read's (two chains are the same only step by step, colors in their declared order), so it reads on its own instead of taking its text from the shared read. json_pointer names the shared read in the package's recognition pack (/candidate_layouts/<i>/shared_ocr). package bundle and actinglab standard-pack check list one entry in warnings per package, target and shared read. Nothing is refused.
package_bundle_preprocess_divergent.common_causes: The chain was edited on the shared read or on the slot target only, or copied with its colors in another order.
package_bundle_preprocess_divergent.handling: Copy the shared read's preprocess to the target verbatim, or remove it from both, unless the target must read on its own.

adopt_refused.description: Workflow #464 P1 (contracts/standard-pack-authoring.md, "The checks"): actinglab standard-pack adopt refused before it wrote anything in the repository, adopt_problem naming the check: repository_invalid (entry the file of --repo that is missing or does not read: applications.json, maintenance.json, packs, schedule.json, or a .part of one an interrupted adoption left, the message naming every leftover and what to do), recording_not_current (path the recording's recording.json, member the member that is not as a stopped recording's last stop left it: schema_version, record_id, status, amended_at_unix_ms or artifact), package_invalid (path the package; the loader's refusal as the cause, or package_id when it names no directory packs/<package_id>), package_mismatch (member game or server: the package's is not applications.json's), pack_exists (entry packs/<package_id>, or json_pointer the rule or held entry of an earlier adoption without --replace; entry packs/<package_id>.part an interrupted adoption left, the message naming every leftover and what to do; path a kept copy's place that is taken), pack_dirty (entry packs/<package_id>, count the paths with a change not committed, or the version control's failure as the cause), recording_unreviewed (package_id: the package is not run through, its cross-check not passed, its first decision not evaluated or a step needing review, and the class is not held; the refusal's details carry review), local_path (entry the package's file, json_pointer the string, which holds an absolute local path or the state directory), decision_invalid (path the decision document and json_pointer the member, or entry schedule.json and json_pointer in the file as it would be written for what the rule keeps: a member missing or wrong, a business rule without its value that is no follower of a chain, pending for a follower, a class beside a maintenance role a root file adopt does not write gives the package, or an outcome predicate on the rule itself on a key its package does not declare, the details carrying declared_outcome_keys), value_origin_model (path the decision document, json_pointer /value/origin: the value names the origin model, which only the model's export writes; give the number with the origin pack, or pending), rule_refused (entry schedule.json, json_pointer the composer's pointer in the file as it would be written, the composer's refusal as the cause; or package_id when the adopted package comes out unclassified), root_file_not_canonical (entry schedule.json or maintenance.json, which adopt must change and which is not in the canonical form package fmt writes), replace_across_volumes (entry packs/<package_id>, path the kept copy's place: with --replace the state directory lies on another volume than the checkout, where the replaced directory cannot be moved, or the volume cannot be told, the failure as the cause; the message says to give a --state-dir on the checkout's volume, and a recording's package by --package), check_tree_unmarked (path the checkout's check tree under the state directory, which holds no marker the tool wrote: it is not the tool's own and is not touched), check_tree_busy (path the check tree, which another adoption of the checkout with the same state directory holds). A refusal of package bundle or standard-pack check of the check tree other than these is answered as it is.
adopt_refused.common_causes: A decision document without a member the class needs, a package adopted before without --replace, a recording whose cross-check was only partly evaluated, a root file formatted by hand.
adopt_refused.handling: Fix what the value names and run the adoption again; it wrote nothing. A root file that is not canonical is written in the canonical form once, in a commit of its own.

adopt_write_failed.description: Workflow #464 P1 (contracts/standard-pack-authoring.md, "What it writes"): a write of actinglab standard-pack adopt failed: path where it stopped (a file or directory of the check tree, of the repository or of the kept copy), paths what it had written or moved before, in order; the operating system's refusal as its cause. Or it stopped because schedule.json or maintenance.json changed after the call read it (path that file, no cause): it renames nothing more and overwrites no other call's work. When the new pack directory cannot take the place of a replaced one, the old one is moved back and the message says so. Nothing is removed in the checkout: a .part left behind and a kept copy stay where they are.
adopt_write_failed.common_causes: Another adoption or a person changed a root file during the call; a file held open by another program; a full disk.
adopt_write_failed.handling: Read the paths, restore the checkout with the version control where it changed, move a .part away by hand, and run the adoption again.
